feature_contract.goal: Continue actual game-native stereo eye frames through transport generation restart in the x64 OpenXR DirectGPU host without reselecting old frames or dropping legitimate new low-frame-ID results. Preserve SBS, gamepad and classic fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Select the newest game Present by QPC when comparing native stereo generations and by frame ordering within a generation.
Recheck exact generation during frame re-read, reject duplicate stale frames, commit current-generation source pair to R23 host-owned GPU hold and OpenXR.
No changes to original D3D9 input/FFB/SkyGlow/DX9Ex or DXVK; untrustworthy competing frame generations are not submitted as valid stereo eyes.
Required DX11 Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD checks succeed at the identical final result SHA; real Quest3 remains UNTESTED.

integration_path: Game D3D9 frame ring produced native stereo per-eye sources with generation/frame/QPC
Host selection chooses newest valid generation by Present QPC, then current-generation frame ordering
R23 validates generation-safe source identity, copies native game eyes to host GPU hold, submits OpenXR; original SBS/input fallback unchanged
batch_components: Actual x64 host DirectGPU OpenXR frame consumer source code
Native generation-aware frame candidate selection and exact source re-read
Positive and negative C++ smoke cases covering Reset/new generation and stale frame

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: New-generation low-frame-ID game output selected over stale higher previous-generation IDs.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Old QPC and ambiguous generations denied, stale consumed IDs cannot suppress new frame and classic fallback remains.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Native full-screen game eye ring -> host DirectGPU latest frame selection -> generation-checked GPU eye hold -> OpenXR projection.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Host runtime smoke and required Actions only; live menu/vehicle/race visual and Quest3 fps NOT TESTED.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Current DirectGPU opt-in only, no promotion; original SBS/D3D9 input FFB SkyGlow remain, DXVK frozen.
